name: Valorant
regionNotes: Fractions of a 16:9 screen with the default HUD. Positions are approximate and move with HUD settings.
cues: The crosshair is always at the screen center.
The kill feed (top right) lists killer, weapon, and victim for a few seconds. Entries with the player in them usually stand out.
After the player dies, the view switches to a teammate or the death recap, so a sudden change of view marks a death.
The scoreboard at the top center shows the round timer and score; a new round starts in a buy phase behind barriers.

habits.name: Crosshair below head level
habits.signs: When an enemy first appears, the crosshair sits at chest height or lower, so the first shot needs a flick up and often loses to a faster head shot.
habits.drill: Ten minutes in a custom game: walk each common angle on one map and hold the crosshair at head height on the edge of the corner before it opens. Then a deathmatch where you check your crosshair height at every corner.

habits.name: Peeking too wide
habits.signs: Swinging far past a corner, so two or more enemies or angles can see the player at once and the duel is not one-on-one.
habits.drill: Custom game: practise slicing a corner one angle at a time with short shoulder peeks. In your next deathmatch, clear each corner in slices instead of one wide swing.

habits.name: Shooting while moving
habits.signs: Firing before the character has stopped, so the first bullets spread off target. In Valorant, moving shots are very inaccurate.
habits.drill: In the Range: strafe, tap the opposite key to stop, fire one shot, and repeat 100 times. Then a deathmatch where you only fire after you have stopped.

habits.name: Spraying at long range
habits.signs: Holding the trigger past the first few bullets at long range, where recoil sends the rest over the target.
habits.drill: In the Range, at the far targets: taps or bursts of 2 to 3 bullets only for 10 minutes. Then a deathmatch tapping at anything past mid range.

habits.name: Re-peeking the same angle
habits.signs: After missing or trading, peeking the same angle again right away, where the enemy is ready and aiming at it.
habits.drill: Deathmatch rule for three games: after any fight at an angle, move or wait before you peek it again.

habits.name: Dying alone, untraded
habits.signs: Dying far from teammates on the minimap, so no one can trade the kill.
habits.drill: For three matches, before you take a fight, check the minimap and stay within trade distance of a teammate.
